title: Amazon in talks to acquire AI chip-software startup Decart for ~$7B
subtitle: The Wall Street Journal reports a possible deal that would hand Amazon cross-silicon inference tooling and real-time video models, nearly doubling Decart's May valuation.
author: AESOP AI Engine
body: Amazon is in advanced talks to acquire Decart, an Israeli AI startup, in a deal that would value the company at around $7 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported on October 11, 2026. Reuters relayed the report and said it could not independently verify the terms. Neither company has confirmed a signed agreement, and sources said other bidders — including Nvidia, which is already a Decart investor — have circled the asset.

What Amazon would get is a cross-silicon inference layer and a video stack. Decart's flagship product is DOS, a software layer that optimizes model execution across Nvidia GPUs, Google TPUs and Amazon's own Trainium chips. On the model side, Decart ships Lucy, a real-time video-editing model, and Oasis, which generates simulated environments for robotics and self-driving training. For Amazon, DOS would help close the gap between Trainium's raw economics and the developer experience of Nvidia-first toolchains.

The valuation jump is the loudest signal. Decart raised at close to a $4 billion valuation in May 2026 in a round led by Radical Ventures with Nvidia participating; a $7 billion sale five months later would be a roughly 75% step-up. That is in line with how 2026 AI M&A has priced inference and compiler software — scarce, strategically important, and expensive enough that strategic buyers now outbid venture rounds within a single quarter.

A takeaway for learners: the layer between model and metal is becoming its own category. If you are early in your career and want to touch the parts of AI that enterprises will actually pay for, invest time in compilers, kernel-level optimization and multi-silicon runtimes. The flashier model-training jobs attract more attention; the plumbing is where the acquisitions are happening.
